school.name: Marble Hill High School for International Studies
school.overview:
Marble Hill SIS is an international community whose student body encompasses over 30+ countries and speaks over 25+ languages. Each 9th grade is composed of 50% ELLs and 50% mainstream students-creating a very diverse and challenging college preparatory learning environment.  Key elements of our school: 4 years of Math and Science, 3 years of a foreign language for mainstream students (Japanese or Italian) and English for ESL students,  7-9 AP courses (11th & 12th grades), Portfolio presentations each semester, Wednesday 12:30 pm early release for community service (100 hour requirement to graduate), Summer bridge for incoming 9th graders 

Key partnerships: DreamYard - provides Arts classes on Wednesday (Drumming, Dance, Drama, Visual Art) and International Poetry Club,  IMentor program - matching adult mentors in working world for our 11th graders & 12th graders,  Student Leadership Network - providing 12-month College Advising for all students. 

Programs outside of school &/or in summers: YABC - Evening paid internships and Summer Search program provides mentors & summer travel nationally & internationally,  CIEE -  International exchange & travel opportunities, SEO (Sponsors for Educational Opportunity), Minds Matter, and Opportunity Network. Pre-college programs at Cornell, NYU, Marist, Syracuse, Skidmore & Tufts.   

Very dedicated and experienced teaching, administration, and support staff.

programs.name: Foreign Language Academy (X43A)
programs.description: College Prep program for mainstream students. All mainstream students in 9th grade will choose a foreign language (Japanese or Italian) and study it for three years. The other courses will be Environmental Science, World Literature, CC Algebra (students who passed CC Algebra in eighth grade with an 85 or higher will move on to CC Geometry). Each Wednesday, students will choose one art form to study for the year, take health and Advisory. Students will take PE two days a week from 3:10pm-4:40pm.

programs.name: English Language Learners Academy (X43B)
programs.eligibility: Open only to New York City residents who currently identify as English Language Learners (ELL) and who have lived in the continental United States fewer than four years.
programs.description: College Prep program for Multilingual Learners (MLL). All MLLs students in 9th grade will have one period of English as a New Language and one English class. The other courses will be Environmental Science, Algebra or Pre-Algebra, and Global History.  All courses are taught in English.  Each Wednesday students will choose one art form to study for the year, take Math and Health class. Students will take PE two days a week from 3:10pm-4:10pm.
